assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
To evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these intermittent symptoms, a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is ordered.
The patient's symptoms are intermittent and require a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study to detect intermittent arrhythmias.
This claim is being appealed as of 127 days since service.
The payer has requested a formal appeal request within ninety days of this notice.
The appeal must include any supporting documentation that may justify an exception to the filing deadline.
